items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 42:1
items.html: Because at the very outset a coupling by striking is required, which reveals the reflected light from below upward, for the phase of ten Sefirot of the Rosh and the roots of the vessels. And afterwards, in order to reveal complete vessels, the reflected light must expand from the screen downward, as above in Item 142. And afterwards the ten Sefirot that conclude the Partzuf are required, which are the ten Sefirot of the Sof. Thus no degree is completed except in the three phases Rosh, Toch and Sof. (Inner Observation, Chapter 5, Item 4)
